questions.text: Match each everyday situation to its appropriate tense.
questions.explanation: 1) A regular timetable — The last bus leaves the station at 10:15 every evening.. Розклад передається Present Simple незалежно від майбутнього значення. 2) An action happening at the moment — Please be quiet: the baby is sleeping upstairs.. Подія відбувається зараз, отже використано Present Continuous. 3) A finished action at a stated past time — We visited the exhibition last Saturday.. Визначений час у минулому потребує Past Simple. 4) Experience without a specified date — Nina has never travelled outside Europe.. Досвід без конкретної дати виражено Present Perfect.

pairs: A regular timetable
The last bus leaves the station at 10:15 every evening.
An action happening at the moment
Please be quiet: the baby is sleeping upstairs.
A finished action at a stated past time
We visited the exhibition last Saturday.
Experience without a specified date
Nina has never travelled outside Europe.

questions.text: Match each time expression to a natural sentence.
questions.explanation: 1) For the past three years — She has worked at this library since 2023.. Тривалість до теперішнього моменту: Present Perfect. 2) At seven yesterday evening — We were preparing dinner when the lights went out.. Процес у конкретний момент минулого: Past Continuous. 3) By the end of next month — The team will have completed the new website.. Future Perfect позначає завершення до майбутньої межі. 4) When I was a child — I used to spend summers at my grandparents' farm.. Used to вказує на колишню звичку.

pairs: For the past three years
She has worked at this library since 2023.
At seven yesterday evening
We were preparing dinner when the lights went out.
By the end of next month
The team will have completed the new website.
When I was a child
I used to spend summers at my grandparents' farm.

questions.text: Match the start of each sentence with its grammatically correct ending.
questions.explanation: 1) While the teacher was explaining the task, — several students were taking notes in their notebooks.. While вводить одночасну тривалу минулу дію. 2) By the time we got to the platform, — the train had already departed.. Попередня завершена дія перед іншою минулою: Past Perfect. 3) If you need help with the report, — I will be available after lunch.. Реальна умова Present Simple поєднується з will. 4) I have not spoken to Daniel — since he moved to another city two years ago.. Since задає початковий момент періоду Present Perfect.

pairs: While the teacher was explaining the task,
several students were taking notes in their notebooks.
By the time we got to the platform,
the train had already departed.
If you need help with the report,
I will be available after lunch.
I have not spoken to Daniel
since he moved to another city two years ago.

questions.text: Match each speaker's intention with the sentence.
questions.explanation: 1) A spontaneous decision — The phone is ringing; I'll answer it.. Will передає рішення, ухвалене в момент мовлення. 2) A plan decided before speaking — We're going to repaint the kitchen this weekend.. Be going to позначає попередньо заплановану дію. 3) An arranged meeting — I'm seeing the dentist at half past nine tomorrow.. Present Continuous уживається для погодженої домовленості. 4) A future event in a published programme — The film starts at six according to the cinema website.. Present Simple виражає подію за розкладом.

pairs: A spontaneous decision
The phone is ringing; I'll answer it.
A plan decided before speaking
We're going to repaint the kitchen this weekend.
An arranged meeting
I'm seeing the dentist at half past nine tomorrow.
A future event in a published programme
The film starts at six according to the cinema website.

questions.text: Match the meaning with the sentence that expresses it.
questions.explanation: 1) An action lasting until a past event — They had been travelling for six hours before the coach broke down.. Past Perfect Continuous підкреслює тривалість перед минулою подією. 2) A recent event with a present result — I have just cleaned the windows, so they are spotless.. Present Perfect із just показує результат тепер. 3) A repeated irritation — My brother is always borrowing my headphones without asking.. Always із Continuous підкреслює роздратування від повторення. 4) An activity in progress at a future time — This time tomorrow, we'll be flying across the Atlantic.. Future Continuous указує на процес у майбутній момент.

pairs: An action lasting until a past event
They had been travelling for six hours before the coach broke down.
A recent event with a present result
I have just cleaned the windows, so they are spotless.
A repeated irritation
My brother is always borrowing my headphones without asking.
An activity in progress at a future time
This time tomorrow, we'll be flying across the Atlantic.

questions.text: Match each subtle contrast to the example.
questions.explanation: 1) A completed achievement within an unfinished period — She has written three essays this week, and it is only Wednesday.. Present Perfect показує результат протягом ще незавершеного тижня. 2) An ongoing activity with a visible consequence — Your hands are covered in paint; you've been decorating the hall.. Perfect Continuous пояснює теперішні сліди тривалої роботи. 3) An earlier event already completed before a deadline — The guests had left by the time the storm began.. Past Perfect розміщує подію перед іншою минулою. 4) A temporary behaviour different from someone's usual character — Leo is being unusually quiet today.. Be being описує тимчасову поведінку, не сталу рису.

pairs: A completed achievement within an unfinished period
She has written three essays this week, and it is only Wednesday.
An ongoing activity with a visible consequence
Your hands are covered in paint; you've been decorating the hall.
An earlier event already completed before a deadline
The guests had left by the time the storm began.
A temporary behaviour different from someone's usual character
Leo is being unusually quiet today.

questions.text: Match the advanced grammatical pattern to the sentence.
questions.explanation: 1) Future viewed from a point in the past — She said she was going to apply for the scholarship.. Was going to переносить майбутній намір у минулий план. 2) An unreal present with a past consequence — If he were more organised, he would not have missed the deadline.. Змішана умова: нереальна теперішня риса вплинула на минуле. 3) An expectation continuing up to a future date — By June, they will have been renovating the house for a year.. Future Perfect Continuous підкреслює тривалість до майбутньої дати. 4) A past habit without implying it happens now — My grandmother would tell us stories every winter evening.. Would + інфінітив може позначати повторювані дії в минулому.

pairs: Future viewed from a point in the past
She said she was going to apply for the scholarship.
An unreal present with a past consequence
If he were more organised, he would not have missed the deadline.
An expectation continuing up to a future date
By June, they will have been renovating the house for a year.
A past habit without implying it happens now
My grandmother would tell us stories every winter evening.

questions.text: Match the grammatical problem to the corrected sentence.
questions.explanation: 1) An incorrect stative verb in a continuous form — I understand what you mean now.. Understand переважно є дієсловом стану, тому Simple. 2) Wrong tense after a future time conjunction — We'll leave as soon as the rain stops.. Після as soon as про майбутнє вживається Present Simple. 3) Confusion between been and gone — Maya has gone to the bank, so she isn't at home.. Has gone означає, що особа ще не повернулася. 4) A double past marking after an auxiliary — They didn't know the answer.. Після did not уживається початкова форма дієслова.

pairs: An incorrect stative verb in a continuous form
I understand what you mean now.
Wrong tense after a future time conjunction
We'll leave as soon as the rain stops.
Confusion between been and gone
Maya has gone to the bank, so she isn't at home.
A double past marking after an auxiliary
They didn't know the answer.

questions.text: Fill in the gaps with the correct verb forms. Every weekday, Ben (1)___ (take) the 7:30 bus to school. His sister usually (2)___ (walk) because she lives nearby. They both (3)___ (enjoy) their morning routine.
questions.explanation: (1) takes — Підмет Ben — третя особа однини в Present Simple. (2) walks — Usually вказує на звичку; she потребує -s. (3) enjoy — They — множина, тому початкова форма в Present Simple.

questions.text: Fill in the gaps with the correct verb forms. Listen! Someone (1)___ (play) the piano next door. My parents (2)___ (watch) a documentary in the living room right now. I (3)___ (write) an email, so I cannot join them yet.
questions.explanation: (1) is playing — Listen сигналізує дію зараз; someone = is + V-ing. (2) are watching — Right now і множина parents потребують are + V-ing. (3) am writing — I у Present Continuous вимагає am + V-ing.

questions.text: Fill in the gaps with the correct verb forms. Yesterday, our class (1)___ (visit) a science museum. We (2)___ (see) an exhibition about space travel. Afterwards, the guide (3)___ (give) us a short quiz.
questions.explanation: (1) visited — Yesterday визначає Past Simple; visit — правильне дієслово. (2) saw — See має неправильну минулу форму saw. (3) gave — Give у Past Simple має форму gave.

questions.text: Fill in the gaps with the correct verb forms. At nine last night, I (1)___ (revise) for a test. My brother (2)___ (cook) dinner when the doorbell rang. By the time our guests arrived, he (3)___ (finish) everything.
questions.explanation: (1) was revising — At nine last night позначає процес у минулому. (2) was cooking — When увів коротку подію, яка перервала процес. (3) had finished — By the time показує завершення перед іншою минулою подією.

questions.text: Fill in the gaps with the correct verb forms. I (1)___ (know) Mia since primary school. She (2)___ (move) to Bristol in 2022, but we still keep in touch. We (3)___ (exchange) messages every weekend since then.
questions.explanation: (1) have known — Since primary school задає тривалість стану до тепер. (2) moved — In 2022 — конкретний завершений час, Past Simple. (3) have exchanged — Since then пов'язує регулярну дію в минулому з теперішнім.

questions.text: Fill in the gaps with the correct verb forms. By the time the interview began, I (1)___ (wait) for nearly an hour. I was nervous because I (2)___ (never / attend) such an interview before. However, when the manager smiled, I suddenly (3)___ (feel) much calmer. Later I realised that my preparation (4)___ (pay) off.
questions.explanation: (1) had been waiting — For nearly an hour до минулої події потребує Past Perfect Continuous. (2) had never attended — Before і минулий орієнтир: Past Perfect заперечного досвіду. (3) felt — Реакція в послідовності подій передається Past Simple. (4) had paid — Підготовка принесла результат до пізнішого усвідомлення.

questions.text: Fill in the gaps with the correct verb forms. The engineers (1)___ (test) the new system for six months by the end of December next year. At this time tomorrow, the director (2)___ (present) their results abroad. Once the report (3)___ (arrive), the team will update the website. The project (4)___ (already / attract) several sponsors this month.
questions.explanation: (1) will have been testing — Тривалість до конкретної майбутньої межі: Future Perfect Continuous. (2) will be presenting — This time tomorrow вказує на майбутній процес. (3) arrives — Після once про майбутнє використовується Present Simple. (4) has already attracted — This month ще триває, а результат уже є; Present Perfect.

questions.text: Fill in the gaps with the correct verb forms. I wish I (1)___ (listen) to the instructions yesterday. If I had paid attention, I (2)___ (avoid) the mistake. Now the instructor expects me (3)___ (rewrite) the whole report. I would rather (4)___ (correct) only the final paragraph, but that isn't possible.
questions.explanation: (1) had listened — Wish щодо жалю про минуле потребує Past Perfect. (2) would have avoided — Нереальна минула умова: would have + V3. (3) to rewrite — Expect + object + to-infinitive. (4) correct — Would rather + bare infinitive без to.

questions.text: Fill in the gaps with the correct verb forms. Rarely (1)___ (I / see) such an impressive performance before last night. No sooner (2)___ (the lights / go) out than the audience fell silent. It was the first time my cousin (3)___ (attend) a live opera. She (4)___ (talk) about it ever since.
questions.explanation: (1) had I seen — Rarely на початку речення викликає інверсію Past Perfect, бо before last night. (2) had the lights gone — No sooner + Past Perfect з інверсією, далі than + Past Simple. (3) had attended — It was the first time + Past Perfect щодо минулого досвіду. (4) has been talking — Ever since до тепер вказує на тривалий повторюваний процес.

questions.text: Fill in the gaps with the correct verb forms. If Nora (1)___ (be) more confident, she would have applied for the position last year. By next spring, she (2)___ (complete) her professional course. She is due (3)___ (meet) a mentor tomorrow, and she promises that she (4)___ (not / make) the same mistake again.
questions.explanation: (1) were — Змішана умовна конструкція: нереальна постійна риса у теперішньому. (2) will have completed — By next spring — завершення до майбутнього терміну. (3) to meet — Be due + to-infinitive позначає заплановану подію. (4) will not make — Promise стосується майбутнього: will not make; скорочена форма won't make також правильна.
